_about: Public-domain William B. Sprague (1795-1876), Presbyterian pastor at Albany, for the Word Hoard: the Annals of the American Pulpit (New York: Robert Carter, 1857-1869, nine volumes; mostly commemorative letters he gathered from many contributors), Lectures on Revivals of Religion (1832) and Lectures illustrating the Contrast between True Christianity and Various Other Systems (1837), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
